name: National Identity Card (NIC) number
issuer: the Department for Registration of Persons
note: The Department for Registration of Persons' page on obtaining the card for the first time (saved 2026-10-28, read again 2026-10-30; drp.gov.lk closed the connection to this egress on 2026-10-30): every citizen of Sri Lanka who has attained or attains 15 shall apply for a National Identity Card. The number's form isn't on the Department's pages read; Hiru News (10 November 2015, trade press reporting the Department's decision) says the Department introduced 12-digit cards from 1 January 2016, without the old English letter, the first four digits the year of birth and a nought inserted before the final four. The pattern reads that: a year of birth from 19 or 20, three more digits, 0, four digits; the meaning of the middle digits and any check digit aren't stated, so neither is held. Old cards (nine digits and a letter) aren't drawn. Read as given on application, from 15, to citizens. The fee (Rs 200 for a first card) belongs to the card, which the ids file holds, not to the number; no time is stated for the number.

sources.title: Department for Registration of Persons, Sri Lanka, Obtaining National Identity Card for the first time
sources.said: Every person who is a citizen of Sri Lanka and who has attained or attains the age of 15 years shall apply for a National Identity card.

sources.title: Hiru News, 12 Digit new National Identity Card (NIC) from 1st January (10 November 2015)
sources.said: The Registration of Persons Department has decided to introduce 12 digit National Identity Cards from the 1st of January. ... The highlight will be the removal of the English letter from the NIC. ... The first four digits of the NIC will contain the year of birth while a naught will be included before the final four digits.
